source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Testing phase (PDF 9).

blocks.text: Jab software ban jata hai to woh ek bohat aham phase se guzarta hai jise testing kehte hain. Testing software ko check karne ka process hai ta ke koi bugs, errors ya masle pehchane ja sakein. Ise quality check samjhein jo yaqeeni banata hai ke sab kuch waisa hi kaam kare jaisa umeed hai. Testing mein software ko mukhtalif halaat (conditions) mein chala kar dekha jata hai ke woh theek kaam karta hai ya nahi. Is mein shamil hai:

items: Functionality Testing: check karna ke software ke tamam features specifications (detail mein likhi requirements) ke mutabiq kaam karte hain.
Performance Testing: check karna ke software mukhtalif halaat mein, jaise zyada traffic (bohat se users) ya bhaari data, achi tarah chalta hai.
Compatibility Testing: yaqeeni banana ke software mukhtalif devices aur operating systems par theek chalta hai.

blocks.text: Testing se woh chhupe hue masle samne aate hain jo development ke dauran nazar nahi aaye thay. In masloon ko theek kar ke developers yaqeeni banate hain ke software aasani se chale aur user ki zarooratein poori kare, aur user ko behtar aur zyada reliable (bharosay wala) tajurba mile.

blocks.prompt: SDLC mein testing phase kyun aham hai? Do wajahein likhein. (Short Question 2)
blocks.explanation: 1) Testing bugs aur chhupe masle users tak pohanchne se pehle pakar leti hai. 2) Yeh check karti hai ke software specifications ke mutabiq kaam kare, zyada traffic ya bhaari data mein bhi chale aur mukhtalif devices par theek ho. Is tarah user ko reliable software milta hai.

items: Testing: bane hue software ko mukhtalif halaat mein chala kar bugs, errors aur masle dhoondna.
Qismein: functionality, performance aur compatibility testing; chhupe masle pakar kar software reliable banati hai.
